name: 11398-solodecode-8b-1gpu
model: Target NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, draft head lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B; neither is substituted. The target id is the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- same weights -- because the canonical repo is `gated: manual`.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- one GPU, unsharded.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 300 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts 24 +- 6 tokens clamped to [12, 48]; generations pinned at exactly 512 tokens with `ignore_eos: true` at `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A single-user creative writing assistant turning brief prompts into 512-token passages with draft-model speculation on one H100.
launch:
# The server's launch arguments. Flat `key: value` only; host/port/served-model-name are owned
# by the serving layer.

# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights: the canonical repo is
# `gated: manual`.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# float16, not the checkpoint's bfloat16: the draft head is a float16 checkpoint.
dtype: float16
attention-backend: triton

# The draft head declares max_position_embeddings 2048 and sglang gives the draft model the
# TARGET's context length, so the server is capped instead. Neutral here: 48 prompt + 512 output.
context-length: 2048

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 6
page-size: 1
max-running-requests: 48
